# Components

<!-- Generated by blockloom-core/tests/reference_docs.rs from the type registry. Rerun it with BLESS=1 after a schema change; don't edit by hand. -->

Every built-in actor component. Defaults are a 3D world's; a 2D one's lengths are in pixels (see Coordinates and units in CLAUDE.md). Edit one with `set-property target=actor:<id>/<Component> path=... value=...`.

## Body

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `physics` | record |  |  |
| `physics.body` | one of `None`, `Static`, `Dynamic`, `Kinematic` | `Dynamic` |  |
| `physics.gravity_scale` | number | `1.0` | Multiplies the world's gravity for this actor alone - `0` for a floating dynamic body, `2` for a heavy one. |
| `physics.lock_rotation` | switch | `false` | Stops a dynamic body from tipping over, the usual want for a platformer character. |
| `physics.restitution` | number | `0.0` |  |
| `physics.friction` | number | `0.5` |  |
| `physics.density` | number | `1.0` | Mass per unit of collider area (2D) or volume (3D): the dial between a balloon and a lead ball of the same size. |
| `physics.mass` | number or none | `null` | An explicit body mass, beating `density` when set - the collider weighs this however big it is. `None` lets shape and density decide. |
| `physics.trigger` | switch | `false` | A trigger collider senses overlap without pushing back: it still fires `when I touch` and answers `touching?`, but the solver never resolves a contact against it. What a coin, a goal zone or a vision cone wants. |
| `physics.one_way` | switch | `false` | In 2D, a static platform supports actors from above while letting them pass through its underside and sides. |
| `physics.character_controller` | switch | `false` | Use Rapier's collision-aware movement for a kinematic actor. |
| `physics.collision_layer` | whole number from 0 | `1` | Which collision layer the actor lives on, 1-8. The solver only pairs two bodies when each one's mask names the other's layer, so walls can ignore the player while the player's feet still raycast against them. |
| `physics.collision_mask` | whole number from 0 | `255` | Bitmask of the layers this actor collides (and raycasts) with, bit `n - 1` for layer `n`. `255` is every layer. |

## Rigidbody

A 2D world starts it with its own defaults.

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rigidbody` | record |  |  |
| `rigidbody.body_type` | one of `Dynamic`, `Kinematic`, `Static` | `Dynamic` |  |
| `rigidbody.simulated` | switch | `true` | 2D only. A body that is not simulated is left out of the world with its colliders. |
| `rigidbody.mass` | one of `Explicit`, `Density` |  |  |
| `rigidbody.mass (Explicit).mass` | number | `1.0` |  |
| `rigidbody.mass (Density).density` | number |  |  |
| `rigidbody.center_of_mass` | x y z or none | `null` | Local centre of mass; `None` computes it from the colliders. |
| `rigidbody.inertia` | x y z or none | `null` | Principal inertia (3D) or the scalar moment (2D, first element); `None` computes it from the colliders. |
| `rigidbody.linear_damping` | number from 0 | `0.0` | **Drag** |
| `rigidbody.angular_damping` | number from 0 | `0.05000000074505806` | **Angular drag** |
| `rigidbody.use_gravity` | switch | `true` | Whether the world's gravity applies at all (Unity's Use Gravity). |
| `rigidbody.gravity_scale` | number | `1.0` | **Gravity ×** Used when `use_gravity` is set. Blockloom's multiplier on top of `use_gravity`. |
| `rigidbody.interpolation` | one of `None`, `Interpolate`, `Extrapolate` | `None` | **Interpolate** |
| `rigidbody.collision_detection` | one of `Discrete`, `Continuous`, `ContinuousDynamic`, `ContinuousSpeculative` | `Discrete` | **Detection** 3D only. |
| `rigidbody.constraints` | record |  |  |
| `rigidbody.constraints.freeze_position` | list of switch | `[false,false,false]` |  |
| `rigidbody.constraints.freeze_rotation` | list of switch | `[false,false,false]` |  |
| `rigidbody.max_linear_velocity` | number from 0.01 | `10000.0` | **Max speed** Advanced. Metres per second. |
| `rigidbody.max_angular_velocity` | number from 0.01 | `7.0` | **Max spin** 3D only. Advanced. Radians per second. |
| `rigidbody.sleep_threshold` | number from 0 | `0.004999999888241291` | **Sleep below** Advanced. Mass-normalised kinetic energy below which the body may sleep. |
| `rigidbody.solver_iterations` | whole number from 0 or none | `null` | **Solver passes** Advanced. Extra solver iterations for this body; `None` uses the world's. |
| `rigidbody.max_depenetration_velocity` | number from 0 (m/s) | `10.0` | **Push-out** Advanced. Metres per second a penetrating contact may push this body out at. |

## Constraint

An actor may carry more than one. A 2D world starts it with its own defaults.

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `constraint` | record |  |  |
| `constraint.id` | JSON |  |  |
| `constraint.name` | text |  | What blocks and scripts call it; unique on its actor. Empty is addressed by its place (`1`, `2`, ...). |
| `constraint.enabled` | switch | `true` |  |
| `constraint.kind` | one of `Fixed`, `Hinge`, `Ball`, `Slider`, `Spring`, `Distance`, `Wheel`, `Configurable` | `Fixed` |  |
| `constraint.target` | text |  | The actor at the other end. Empty anchors the constraint to the world. |
| `constraint.anchor` | x y z | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | Where it attaches, in this actor's own frame. |
| `constraint.connected_anchor` | x y z | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | Where it attaches on the target (in the target's frame, or the world's when there is no target). Used when `auto_configure` is off. |
| `constraint.auto_configure` | switch | `true` | Work the other end's anchor and axis out from where the two actors stand, so nothing snaps when Play starts. |
| `constraint.axis` | x y z | `[1.0,0.0,0.0]` | The hinge, slide or wheel axis in this actor's frame. |
| `constraint.connected_axis` | x y z | `[1.0,0.0,0.0]` |  |
| `constraint.limit` | record |  | Limits the free axis (hinge angle, slide travel, spring travel). |
| `constraint.limit.enabled` | switch | `false` |  |
| `constraint.limit.min` | number | `0.0` |  |
| `constraint.limit.max` | number | `0.0` |  |
| `constraint.motor` | record |  |  |
| `constraint.motor.mode` | one of `Off`, `Velocity`, `Position` | `Off` |  |
| `constraint.motor.target` | number | `0.0` | Velocity (degrees or units per second) or position (degrees or units). |
| `constraint.motor.max_force` | number | `0.0` | The most force or torque the motor may use; 0 means no limit. |
| `constraint.motor.stiffness` | number | `100.0` | Position mode: how hard it pulls towards the target. |
| `constraint.motor.damping` | number | `10.0` |  |
| `constraint.spring` | record |  |  |
| `constraint.spring.stiffness` | number | `100.0` |  |
| `constraint.spring.damping` | number | `10.0` |  |
| `constraint.spring.rest_length` | number | `1.0` | The distance the spring settles at. |
| `constraint.min_distance` | number | `0.0` | A distance constraint's range. |
| `constraint.max_distance` | number | `1.0` |  |
| `constraint.axes` | list of one of `Locked`, `Limited`, `Free` |  | The six axes of a configurable constraint: x, y, z then the three turns. |
| `constraint.axis_limits` | list of list of number |  |  |
| `constraint.break_force` | number or none | `null` | The joint snaps when it carries more than this force or torque. |
| `constraint.break_torque` | number or none | `null` |  |
| `constraint.enable_collision` | switch | `false` | Whether the two bodies still collide with each other. |
| `constraint.break_message` | text |  | Broadcast when the constraint breaks; empty says nothing. |

## CharacterController

A 2D world starts it with its own defaults.

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `controller` | record |  |  |
| `controller.enabled` | switch | `true` |  |
| `controller.center` | x y z | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | **Centre** Where the capsule's centre stands, from the actor's origin. |
| `controller.radius` | number from 0.001 | `0.5` |  |
| `controller.height` | number from 0 | `2.0` | Total height, caps included. At least twice the radius. |
| `controller.slope_limit` | number 0 to 90 (°) | `45.0` | Steepest walkable slope, degrees from flat. |
| `controller.step_offset` | number from 0 | `0.30000001192092896` | Tallest step it walks onto. |
| `controller.skin_width` | number from 0.0001 | `0.07999999821186066` | The gap kept between the capsule and what it touches. |
| `controller.min_move_distance` | number from 0 | `0.0010000000474974513` | **Minimum move** A move shorter than this does not move. |
| `controller.detect_collisions` | switch | `true` | Whether other bodies and controllers collide with this capsule. |
| `controller.overlap_recovery` | switch | `true` | Push the capsule out of whatever it overlaps before it moves. |
| `controller.layer` | whole number 1 to 32 | `1` | Layer slot, 1 to 32, that the capsule lives on and sweeps as. |
| `controller.layer_overrides` | record |  | Advanced. |
| `controller.layer_overrides.include` | whole number from 0 | `0` |  |
| `controller.layer_overrides.exclude` | whole number from 0 | `0` |  |
| `controller.layer_overrides.priority` | whole number | `0` | Higher wins when two overrides disagree on a pair. |
| `controller.up` | x y z | `[0.0,1.0,0.0]` | Advanced. The direction that is up (3D profile: +Y). In 2D the z is ignored. |

## CharacterMotor

A 2D world starts it with its own defaults.

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `motor` | record |  |  |
| `motor.enabled` | switch | `true` |  |
| `motor.owner` | one of `Player`, `Ai`, `Script` | `Player` | **Driven by** |
| `motor.player` | whole number 0 to 7 | `0` | Used when `owner` is `Player`. Which local player's actions drive it (0 is the first), when owned by the player. |
| `motor.space` | one of `World`, `Actor`, `Camera` | `Camera` | **Move space** 3D only. |
| `motor.top_down` | switch | `false` | 2D only. Move across the whole plane with no up, gravity or jump. |
| `motor.walk_speed` | number from 0 | `5.0` |  |
| `motor.sprint_speed` | number from 0 | `8.0` |  |
| `motor.crouch_speed` | number from 0 | `2.5` |  |
| `motor.ground_acceleration` | number from 0 | `50.0` | **Acceleration** Speeding up on the ground, units a second squared. |
| `motor.ground_braking` | number from 0 | `60.0` | **Braking** Slowing down on the ground when nothing is asked. |
| `motor.air_acceleration` | number from 0 | `15.0` |  |
| `motor.air_control` | number 0 to 1 | `1.0` | How much of the steering the air keeps (0 none, 1 all of it). |
| `motor.turn_speed` | number from 0 (°/s) | `720.0` | 3D only. Turn the actor towards where it moves, degrees a second (0 = never). |
| `motor.normalize_input` | switch | `true` | Scale a diagonal intent back to unit length. |
| `motor.gravity_scale` | number from 0 | `1.0` |  |
| `motor.terminal_fall_speed` | number from 0.001 | `50.0` | **Terminal speed** The fastest it falls, along up. |
| `motor.ground_snap_distance` | number from 0 | `0.30000001192092896` | **Ground snap** After a move that leaves the ground, reach down this far to stay on it. |
| `motor.slide_on_steep` | switch | `false` | Slide down slopes past the controller's limit. |
| `motor.slide_speed` | number from 0 | `6.0` | Used when `slide_on_steep` is set. |
| `motor.jump_height` | number from 0 | `1.2000000476837158` |  |
| `motor.max_jumps` | whole number from 0 | `1` |  |
| `motor.jump_cut` | number 0 to 1 | `0.5` | Letting go of jump while rising scales the rise by this (1 = no cut). |
| `motor.coyote_time` | number from 0 (s) | `0.10000000149011612` |  |
| `motor.jump_buffer` | number from 0 (s) | `0.10000000149011612` |  |
| `motor.crouch_height` | number from 0 | `1.0` | The controller's height while crouching (0 = cannot crouch). |
| `motor.external_drag` | number from 0 | `20.0` | **Knockback drag** How fast knockback and impulses fade, units a second squared. |

## PlayerCamera

A 2D world starts it with its own defaults.

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `player_camera` | record |  |  |
| `player_camera.enabled` | switch | `true` |  |
| `player_camera.player` | whole number 0 to 7 | `0` | Which local player's Look actions turn it (0 is the first). |
| `player_camera.look` | switch | `true` | **Look input** 3D only. Look input turns the view. Off keeps the Camera component's fixed framing. |
| `player_camera.sensitivity` | number from 0 | `0.11999999731779099` | Used when `look` is set. 3D only. Degrees a mouse count turns the view. |
| `player_camera.stick_speed` | number from 0 (°/s) | `180.0` | Used when `look` is set. 3D only. Degrees a second at full stick deflection. |
| `player_camera.invert_y` | switch | `false` | **Invert Y** Used when `look` is set. 3D only. |
| `player_camera.min_pitch` | number -89 to 89 (°) | `-80.0` | Used when `look` is set. 3D only. |
| `player_camera.max_pitch` | number -89 to 89 (°) | `80.0` | Used when `look` is set. 3D only. |
| `player_camera.turn_body` | switch | `false` | Used when `look` is set. 3D only. Turn the body to face where the camera looks (first person). |
| `player_camera.smoothing` | number from 0 (s) | `0.0` | Seconds the camera takes to catch up (0 follows exactly). |
| `player_camera.collision` | switch | `true` | **Avoid walls** 3D only. Third person: pull in so walls never sit between camera and target. |
| `player_camera.collision_radius` | number from 0 | `0.25` | **Lens radius** Used when `collision` is set. 3D only. Radius of the swept ball that keeps the lens off a wall. |
| `player_camera.min_distance` | number from 0 | `0.6000000238418579` | **Closest** Used when `collision` is set. 3D only. Closest the camera is pulled to the target. |
| `player_camera.zoom` | switch | `false` | **Scroll zoom** 3D only. Scroll or triggers change the distance within these limits. |
| `player_camera.zoom_min` | number from 0.1 | `2.0` | Used when `zoom` is set. 3D only. |
| `player_camera.zoom_max` | number from 0.1 | `12.0` | Used when `zoom` is set. 3D only. |
| `player_camera.zoom_speed` | number from 0 | `1.0` | Used when `zoom` is set. 3D only. |
| `player_camera.dead_zone` | list of number | `[0.0,0.0]` | 2D only. Side and top-down views: how far the target walks before the camera follows, each side of the centre. |
| `player_camera.look_ahead` | number from 0 | `0.0` | 2D only. How far ahead of a moving target the camera looks. |
| `player_camera.look_ahead_smoothing` | number from 0 (s) | `0.25` | 2D only. Seconds the look-ahead takes to build or fade. |
| `player_camera.eye_follows_stance` | switch | `true` | **Eye follows crouch** 3D only. A first-person eye drops and rises with a crouch. |

## Light

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `light` | record |  |  |
| `light.kind` | one of `Point`, `Spot`, `Rect`, `Disk` | `Point` | **Kind** |
| `light.color` | color | `#FFFFFF` |  |
| `light.intensity` | number from 0 | `800.0` | Luminous power in lumens. A household bulb is about 800. A spot's power isn't gathered into its cone, so a narrow one is no brighter. |
| `light.range` | number from 0.01 (m) | `20.0` | Metres past which the light no longer reaches. |
| `light.radius` | number from 0 (m) | `0.0` | Used when `kind` is one of Point, Spot. Metres. A bigger emitter softens highlights and shadow edges. |
| `light.inner_angle` | number 0 to 179 (°) | `30.0` | **Cone inner** Used when `kind` is `Spot`. Degrees from the spot's axis where the falloff starts. |
| `light.outer_angle` | number 0 to 179 (°) | `45.0` | **Cone outer** Used when `kind` is `Spot`. Degrees from the spot's axis where the light ends. |
| `light.shadows` | switch | `false` | Used when `kind` is one of Point, Spot. Whether the light casts shadow maps. An area light casts a point light's, from its centre. |
| `light.unit` | one of `Lumens`, `Candela` | `Lumens` | **Unit** |
| `light.width` | number from 0.01 (m) | `1.0` | **Size** Used when `kind` is one of Rect, Disk. Metres across a rect light (or a disk's diameter), and a rect's height. |
| `light.height` | number from 0.01 (m) | `1.0` | Used when `kind` is `Rect`. |
| `light.cookie` | image asset |  | Used when `kind` is `Spot`. An image asset projected through the light like a gobo; only its red channel counts. A point light repeats it on each of its six sides. Empty for none. |
| `light.cookie_tiling` | number from 0.01 | `1.0` | **Tiling** Used when `kind` is `Spot` and `cookie` is set. How many times the cookie repeats across the beam. |
| `light.ies` | light asset |  | **IES profile** Used when `kind` is one of Point, Spot. An `.ies` profile shaping a spot's beam. With `LightUnit::Candela`, `intensity` is the profile's peak. |
| `light.contact_shadows` | switch | `false` | **Contact** Used when `kind` is one of Point, Spot. Screen-space shadows under feet and small clutter, which shadow maps are too coarse to catch. Needs the project's contact shadows on. |
| `light.soft_shadows` | switch | `false` | **Soft (PCSS)** Used when `kind` is one of Point, Spot and `shadows` is set. Shadows that soften with distance from their caster (PCSS). Needs the light's `radius` above zero to have a size to soften by. |
| `light.shadow_depth_bias` | number from 0 or none | `null` | **Depth bias** Used when `kind` is one of Point, Spot and `shadows` is set. Overrides Bevy's own shadow biases when set. |
| `light.shadow_normal_bias` | number from 0 or none | `null` | **Normal bias** Used when `kind` is one of Point, Spot and `shadows` is set. |
| `light.ray_traced` | switch | `true` | **Traced** Whether ray-traced lighting traces this light. Off leaves it out of the traced world, lighting only what the raster rig still draws. |
| `light.volumetric` | switch | `true` | **Lights fog** Whether it lights volumetric fog. |
| `light.beam` | record |  | Used when `kind` is one of Point, Spot. A visible beam of its own, and the dust drifting in it. |
| `light.beam.density` | number 0 to 10 (/m) | `0.0` | **Beam** Used when `/volumetric` is set. Extinction per metre added in the beam. 0 for no beam. |
| `light.beam.anisotropy` | number -0.9 to 0.9 or none | `null` | **Own g** Used when `/volumetric` is set and `density` is set. Henyey-Greenstein g for this light alone, or the fog's when unset. |
| `light.beam.falloff` | number 0 to 8 | `1.0` | **Falloff curve** Used when `/volumetric` is set and `density` is set. Exponent on `1 - distance / range`: 0 flat, 1 linear, 2 quadratic. |
| `light.beam.near_fade` | number from 0 (m) | `0.5` | **Fade near** Used when `/volumetric` is set and `density` is set. Metres from the light over which the beam fades in. |
| `light.beam.far_fade` | number from 0 (m) | `2.0` | **Fade far** Used when `/volumetric` is set and `density` is set. Metres before the range over which it fades out. |
| `light.beam.mode` | one of `Auto`, `Volumetric`, `Shaft` | `Auto` | **Drawn as** Used when `/volumetric` is set and `density` is set. |
| `light.beam.shaft_intensity` | number from 0 | `1.0` | **Shaft** Used when `/kind` is `Spot` and `/volumetric` is set and `density` is set and `mode` isn't `Volumetric`. Shaft cone brightness multiplier. |
| `light.beam.shaft_noise` | number 0 to 1 | `0.4000000059604645` | **Shaft noise** Used when `/kind` is `Spot` and `/volumetric` is set and `density` is set and `mode` isn't `Volumetric`. How much the shaft's noise carves it, 0-1, and how fast it scrolls. |
| `light.beam.shaft_scroll` | number (m/s) | `0.30000001192092896` | **Shaft scroll** Used when `/kind` is `Spot` and `/volumetric` is set and `density` is set and `mode` isn't `Volumetric`. |
| `light.beam.motes` | record |  | **Dust motes** |
| `light.beam.motes.enabled` | switch | `false` | **On** |
| `light.beam.motes.count` | whole number 0 to 4096 | `160` | Used when `enabled` is set. |
| `light.beam.motes.size` | number 0.001 to 1 (m) | `0.012000000104308128` | Used when `enabled` is set. Metres across one mote. |
| `light.beam.motes.alpha` | number 0 to 1 | `0.6000000238418579` | Used when `enabled` is set. 0-1 opacity at full light. |
| `light.beam.motes.twinkle` | number 0 to 1 | `0.5` | Used when `enabled` is set. 0-1: how much each mote flickers. |

| `water.ripples.enabled` | switch | `true` |  |
| `water.ripples.speed` | number | `2.0` | How fast a ring spreads, world units a second. |
| `water.ripples.fade` | number | `3.0` | Seconds until a ripple has mostly died away. |
| `water.ripples.wake` | number | `1.0` | 0-2: how much a floating body stirs the water as it moves. |
| `water.ripples.extent` | number | `48.0` | World units the simulated patch spans. A body smaller than this is covered whole; a bigger one gets a patch that follows the camera. |

## Buoyancy

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `buoyancy` | record |  |  |
| `buoyancy.density` | number | `0.5` | Against water's: 0.5 floats half under, 1 hangs, above 1 sinks. |
| `buoyancy.drag` | number | `1.0` | How hard the water holds the body to its own motion, per second. |
| `buoyancy.angular_drag` | number | `1.0` | How hard it damps the body's spin, per second. |
| `buoyancy.points` | whole number from 0 | `4` | Where the water is sampled: 1 at the centre, 4 on the corners of the footprint (tips and rolls with the waves), 8 on the box's corners. |
| `buoyancy.splash` | switch | `true` | Whether this body splashes when it hits the water. |

## Parallax

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `parallax` | record |  |  |
| `parallax.scroll` | list of number | `[0.5,0.5]` | How far the layer moves per unit the camera moves, 0-2 per axis: 0 hangs on the camera like a sky, 1 is the actors' own plane, above 1 sweeps past as foreground. |
| `parallax.wrap` | list of switch | `[false,false]` | Repeats along x and y, so the layer never runs out. |
| `parallax.dim` | number | `0.0` | 0-1: how far a distant layer fades towards the background color, scaled by its distance from the actors' plane (\|1 - scroll\|). |

## Room

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `room` | record |  |  |
| `room.size` | list of number | `[1280.0,720.0]` | World units across and up, before the actor's scale. |
| `room.depth` | number | `720.0` | World units deep (z), before the actor's scale. 3D only: a 2D room reaches every layer. |
| `room.camera` | switch | `true` | Keeps the camera inside the room while its target is in it. |
| `room.blend` | number | `0.4000000059604645` | Seconds the camera takes to slide into a newly entered room. |
| `room.stream` | switch | `false` | Builds the tilemaps inside it only while it is near the camera, through the streaming cells. |
